meta.title: Your logger knows what you did. It cannot tell you what to do next.
meta.status: DRAFT — not publish-ready until compliance-reviewer PASS is on record

slides.heading: Your logger knows what you did.
slides.supporting: It cannot tell you what to do next.

slides.heading: Strong and Hevy record the session.
slides.supporting: Every set, every rep, saved and stacked.

slides.heading: A food app records what you ate.
slides.supporting: Calories and macros, totalled for the day.

slides.heading: Then the week ends, and the question sits there.
slides.supporting: What do I actually change now?

slides.heading: A proper weekly review looks at both sides together.
slides.supporting: The bodyweight trend, the sets you completed, how recovery held.

slides.heading: Deciding is the part loggers leave to you.
slides.supporting: Recording is solved. The weekly call is the work.

slides.heading: Volyume is the connected system that makes that call.
slides.supporting: It reads your training and your food, then decides change or hold with the reason shown.
